description: Soft Snickerdoodle cookies! 🍂🤎🍪 ⭐️Ingredients⭐️ Recipe makes around 9 cookies 165g flour 1/2 tsp baking soda 113g unsalted butter, room temperature  🧈  80g granulated sugar  1 large egg 🥚  1 tsp vanilla extract  1/4 tsp cinnamon  Cinnamon sugar coating 2 tbsp sugar 1 tbsp cinnamon  Icing 50g unsalted butter, room temperature  90g cream cheese 65g icing sugar  Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 10 minutes! 💞 #baking #cookies #snickerdoodle #snickerdoodlecookies #fallbaking
